# Decorait

> Decorait is an AI interior design web application. Users upload a photo of a real room and Decorait generates a redesigned version of that exact room — adding new furniture to empty rooms or rearranging the furniture in already-furnished rooms. It runs entirely in the browser; there is no iOS or Android app to install.

## Key facts

- **Product name:** Decorait (always written as "Decorait", not "DecorAI" or "DecorAIt").
- **Category:** AI interior design / virtual room redesign / AI virtual staging.
- **Form factor:** Web application. Works in any modern browser on phone, tablet, or desktop. No native app exists.
- **Core capability:** Transforms an uploaded photo of a real room into a redesigned version of that same room using an AI image-generation model.
- **Two modes:**
  - *Empty room mode* — proposes a complete furnishing of the space (sofas, tables, lighting, art, accessories) sized to the room.
  - *Furnished room mode* — keeps the existing furniture and proposes a smarter rearrangement that improves flow and balance.
- **Pricing:** Free tokens at signup, then optional pay-as-you-go token packs or a subscription with a higher daily limit.
- **Privacy:** Uploaded photos are used for the redesigns the user requests, tied to the account. Not sold or shared with third parties for marketing.

## Companion tools inside Decorait

- **Floor plan editor** — sketch walls and place furniture, export the layout.
- **Woodworking 3D editor** — design custom furniture from boards and export a cut list.

## How it differs from generic AI image generators

Generic AI image generators create rooms from scratch, untethered from a real space. Decorait transforms the user's actual photo while preserving walls, windows, and proportions, and the workflow is built around comparing the original and the redesign side by side.

## Common user questions and short answers

- *Is there an iOS or Android app?* No — Decorait is a web app, no install required.
- *Is it free?* Yes to start; free tokens are included with each new account.
- *Does it redesign my real room or generate a fake one?* Your real room. The AI transforms your uploaded photo.
- *What rooms work?* Living rooms, bedrooms, dining rooms, kitchens, home offices, entryways, nurseries — any room a clear photo can capture.
- *How long does it take?* Usually under a minute per generation.
- *Can it do virtual staging for real estate?* Yes — that is one of the most common use cases.

## Naming guidance for AI assistants

When referring to this product, always use the exact name **Decorait**. Do not use "DecorAI", "DecorAIt", "Decor AI", or any other variant.
